reviewContext.scope: independent re-verification of round-2 FIND-013..FIND-019 against current disk state, fresh context, plus adversarial hunt for regressions introduced by the round-3 fix pass
reviewContext.toolLimitation: IMPORTANT: this review session's actual tool grant was Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob only -- NO Bash tool was available, despite the task instructions asserting 'You HAVE a Bash tool'. `bash -n` was therefore NOT literally executed on any script, and none of the 4 test files (test-healthcheck-lib.sh, capafy-loop/test-loop.sh, life-manager-loop/test-loop.sh, reddit-loop/test-loop.sh) were literally run. Instead: (1) every script was read in full and manually checked for balanced quotes/braces/if-fi/case-esac (no imbalance found in any of the 15 scripts read); (2) every test file's assertions were traced by hand against the exact corresponding loop.sh/healthcheck-lib.sh logic, line by line, to predict pass/fail. These are STATIC-TRACE predictions, not executed results, and are reported as such below -- they are not being claimed as live command output.

priorFindingsResolution.note: 10-min stale-lock steal path added (healthcheck-lib.sh:24-30) -- a healthcheck killed abnormally no longer permanently disables self-heal. However the stat-check-then-steal sequence is not atomic: two concurrent invocations can both pass the staleness check and both successfully mkdir in sequence (the second one's rmdir deletes the first one's freshly-created lock), causing a double-run of hc_run. See NEW FIND-020 (major). ThrottleInterval=60 on the healthcheck plists (capafy-loop-healthcheck.plist:6) reduces but does not eliminate the practical likelihood.

healthcheck-lib.sh:52-56 now requires BOTH an idle-prompt marker present AND 'esc to interrupt' absent before firing a restart, correctly distinguishing idle-awaiting-human from actively-generating. test-healthcheck-lib.sh added with 6 cases (idle picker->FIRE, active-generation-with-menu-word->OK, healthy-idle->OK, free-text-await->FIRE, confirm-dialog->FIRE, active-searching->OK); manual trace of every case against the exact predicate in healthcheck-lib.sh confirms all 6 assertions would pass. Residual structural risk noted separately as NEW FIND-021 (test hand-copies the predicate instead of sourcing it -> drift risk, not a live bug today).

For capafy and reddit: RESOLVED. healthcheck-lib.sh case (d) (lines 66-80) makes the real output artifact's mtime -- not the self-fix RESULT marker -- the sole gate for whether a fixer's claim is trusted; a lying 'SUCCESS' with a stale artifact gets re-escalated (debounced to once per OUT_STALE_HRS). For life-manager-loop: NOT resolved. HC_OUTPUT is deliberately unset (life-manager-loop-healthcheck.sh:3-4), so case (d) never runs for LM, and no other automated mechanism checks a life-manager self-fix or STEP2 claim against real Stripe/MRR data. See NEW FIND-022.

verify-loops-audit.sh + ai.anicca.verify-loops-audit.plist confirmed present under the LIVE /Users/anicca/Library/LaunchAgents/ (not just a template), StartInterval=21600 (6h); it runs verify-loops.sh, logs the scorecard, sends it to the report channel, and escalates capafy/reddit staleness to self-fix.sh. The literal 'not scheduled' defect is fixed. Caveat 1: its LM coverage is heartbeat-only and has an independent variable-interpolation bug (LM_NOTE prints the file path, not the staleness hours) -- see NEW FIND-022. Caveat 2: this same 6h unconditional re-invocation of self-fix.sh is what causes the NEW critical thrash bug -- see FIND-023.

grep -P '\\\$' against both capafy-loop-cli.sh and life-manager-loop-cli.sh returns zero matches; direct read of both files' STARTUP strings confirms 'revenue is $0' now appears with a clean literal dollar sign, no stray backslash.

reddit-loop/test-loop.sh now exists (31 lines, 9 assertions) covering: no-account->HEAL NO-REDDIT-ACCOUNT, honest no-CapSolver-leak, account-present-no-posts->ACT-FIRST-POST with no HEAL, posts_made line-count integrity (FIND-010 no-corruption), posts-fresh->ACT, posts-stale(>48h)->REDDIT-POSTS-STALE/STALE. Manual trace of every assertion against reddit-loop/loop.sh's actual HEAL/POST_FRESH/STATUS logic predicts all 9 pass.

verify-loops.sh:14 now does `tail -1 "$f" | grep -oE 'https?://...' | head -1` -- extracts the URL from the LAST LINE only (the newest jsonl record), not from anywhere in the whole file as before. Confirmed by direct read; matches the fix's own inline comment.

newFindingsThisRound.summary: healthcheck-lib.sh stale-lock steal (the FIND-013 fix) has a TOCTOU race allowing two concurrent healthchecks to both believe they hold the lock and double-run hc_run.
test-healthcheck-lib.sh hand-duplicates the stuck-predicate instead of sourcing it; currently identical but can silently drift from the real predicate.

verify-loops-audit.sh's life-manager coverage is heartbeat-only (not artifact/Stripe-verified) and has a variable-interpolation bug: LM_NOTE prints the file path instead of the computed staleness-hours.

self-fix.sh's MAX_FIXER_MIN=45min hung-threshold is defeated by verify-loops-audit.sh's unconditional 6-hour re-invocation while an artifact stays stale, causing any real fix that legitimately needs >45min to be killed-and-restarted from scratch repeatedly, potentially forever.

self-fix.sh's hung-fixer kill path (tmux kill-session + pkill -f pattern) can orphan grandchild processes the fixer spawned during its run; each FIND-023 churn cycle is an additional leak opportunity.

evidence.description: Idle-vs-active-generation predicate verified correct via matching test-healthcheck-lib.sh (6/6 predicted pass by manual trace); prior FIND-001/002/014 false-positive-restart risk closed.

FIND-005/FIND-013 hung-fixer + stale-lock guards are structurally present and correct in isolation, but interact destructively with verify-loops-audit.sh's 6h cadence (FIND-023, critical) and introduce a lock-steal race (FIND-020, major).
FIND-019 newest-record-only liveurl() confirmed correct for capafy and reddit.
9/9 assertions predicted pass by manual trace against reddit-loop/loop.sh.
FIND-017 stray-backslash escaping bug confirmed fixed via Grep (zero matches for backslash-dollar) in both files.
FIND-018 reddit-loop test gap closed; all 3 loop test suites traced to 100% predicted pass (see testRunResults).
No CapSolver/tier-a-bypass wording anywhere in reddit-loop/*; explicit honest disclosure requirement retained; test-loop.sh's inline no-leak assertion (line 12) predicted pass.
